description: Angular component for displaying and managing attribute data in a table, including features like filtering, editing, deleting, and widget integration within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: AttributeTableComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing attribute data table with filtering, editing, deletion, and widget features in Thingsboard.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes resize observer and subscribes to data source selection changes.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer and subscriptions.

methods.name: attributeScopeChanged
methods.description: Handles change in attribute scope and updates data accordingly.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up value change handling for search input and sorting/pagination event subscriptions.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Loads attribute data based on current filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: enterFilterMode
methods.description: Enables text search filter mode and focuses input.

methods.name: exitFilterMode
methods.description: Disables filter mode and resets search input.

methods.name: resetSortAndFilter
methods.description: Resets sorting and filtering to default states based on entity type.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Opens dialog to add new attribute.

methods.name: editAttribute
methods.description: Opens overlay to edit attribute value.

methods.name: deleteTimeseries
methods.description: Opens overlay to delete timeseries data.

methods.name: deleteTelemetry
methods.description: Deletes telemetry data or attributes based on scope.

methods.name: enterWidgetMode
methods.description: Switches component to widget mode, preparing widget data sources.

methods.name: onWidgetsCarouselIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles change in widget carousel index.

methods.name: onWidgetsBundleChanged
methods.description: Loads widgets from selected bundle and prepares them for display.

methods.name: addWidgetToDashboard
methods.description: Opens dialog to add current widget configuration to dashboard.

methods.name: exitWidgetMode
methods.description: Exits widget mode and resets related state.
